top_level_subtrees.code: Public minimal runnable code closure for rerun and validation.
top_level_subtrees.data/paper_release: Paper-facing released data, staged inputs, and appendix-support outputs.
top_level_subtrees.data/canonical_full: Full canonical rerun results copied into the release package.
